load_seq2seq_model_t5: load a T5 seq2seq language model from google-t5/t5-small for text2text generation using AutoModelForSeq2SeqLM
load_seq2seq_model_custom_path: load a seq2seq language model from a local model folder path for conditional text generation
load_seq2seq_model_custom_seq_len: load a seq2seq model with custom max_hidden_seq_len and max_seq_len kwargs for export to ExecuTorch
export_seq2seq_to_executorch: create a Seq2SeqLMExportableModule from a pretrained seq2seq model ready for lowering to ExecuTorch
register_seq2seq_task: register a text2text-generation task using the register_task decorator for dynamic task discovery
